exposure: mode of acquisition of HCV infection
finding: Invasive procedures such as fetal scalp blood sampling or internal electrode and episiotomy increase vertical transmission of HCV, especially in patients with positive HCV RNA virus load at delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of perinatal transmission of hepatitis C virus (HCV), particularly in the presence of other risk factors like maternal HCV viral load and episiotomy.
